searchText: Very useful, thanks! The conclusions state that decoding with SSZ gains more advantage as the blob count increases — but it looks like it (almost) consistently underperforms JSON (by a short margin). Is this an impl thing? Would be great to have benchmarks across all impls. And maybe agree on a trigger condition to seriously consider a migration, eg. when the delta represents 1% of block validation time (4s).
